# PositioningHQ

Free · Open source

One story, told the same way by every rep. Claude skills that build your Positioning Playbook, then turn it into battlecards and call plans your team uses in live deals.

At a glance

-   A 7-part Positioning Playbook
-   One battlecard per competitor
-   A pre-call brief for any deal, any stage
-   Set up in about 15 minutes
-   Works in the Claude desktop app

## Every rep tells a different story.

Marketing says one thing, sales says another, and the website says a third. Buyers notice, and it costs you deals you should win.

## Build the playbook once. Use it in every deal.

1.  01
    
    ### Set up
    
    `/setup-positioning-vault` collects your context, researches your market and competitors, and drafts the playbook.
    
2.  02
    
    ### Build the playbook
    
    Seven sections: why now, ideal customer, value drivers, competitive moat, competitive intelligence, positioning and proof points. Your team's single source of truth.
    
3.  03
    
    ### Use it in deals
    
    Battlecards for every competitor, a call plan before every important meeting, and a sales coach for live opportunities.
    

## The skills.

/setup-positioning-vault

Start here. One-time setup that runs the research and the playbook for you.

/company-research

Market and competitive analysis: where you win and where competitors are weak.

/positioning-playbook

The full seven-section Positioning Playbook.

/battlecard

How to position and win against each competitor.

/call-plan

Opening hypothesis, discovery questions, proof points and next step for any call.

/sales-coach

A MEDDIC-trained sparring partner that finds the gaps in a live deal.

/product-launch

A launch plan: positioning impact, messaging and rollout.

Framework informed by the work of April Dunford. Requires a paid Claude plan.
